svg.title: Valve — vacuum tube robot
svg.desc: A broad burnt orange robot whose head is a tall glass vacuum tube on a pinned slate base, with a glowing filament grid and two small eyes inside the glass, a row of knobs and a meter on its chest, ring jointed arms with pincers and legs on round feet.
